channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Gold sticks to gains on softer bond yields and subdued USD; hawkish Fed caps upside
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some buyers for the second straight day, though it remains below the weekly top through the Asian session on Friday amid mixed cues.

item.title: Swiss Franc gains ground as easing US Yields pressures Greenback
item.description: USD/CHF extends its losses for the second successive day, trading around 0.8230 during Asian hours on Friday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) faced challenges from falling oil prices, which helped ease broader inflation concerns.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Strengthens to near 1.1500, while bearish bias persists below 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1490 during the early European session on Friday, bolstered by a weaker US Dollar (USD). However, the potential upside of the major pair might be limited amid a hawkish interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Consolidates below mid-$96.00s as Mideast jitters favor bulls
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on the overnight modest bounce from the $94.65 area, or the weekly low, and remains on the defensive during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar steadies as softer US bond yields keep USD on the defensive
item.description: The NZD/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest recovery gains and edges lower during the Asian session on Friday. Spot prices, however, hold above the lowest level since July 9, touched on Wednesday, and currently trade around the 0.5730 region, nearly unchanged for the day.

item.title: Australian Dollar rises against Japanese Yen as BOJ raises policy rate to the highest since 1995
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross rises to around 112.05 during the Asian trading hours on Friday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) attracts some sellers against the Australian Dollar (AUD) following the Bank of Japan (BoJ) interest rate decision.

item.title: United States Dollar Index trades firmly above 100.00 while approaching to weekend
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) consolidates in a tight range during the Asian trading session on Friday, but is close to its highest level seen in the last six weeks. At press time, the US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback’s value against six major currencies, trades firmly near 100.27.

item.title: Euro gains momentum against Japanese Yen as BoJ aligns on rate hikes
item.description: EUR/JPY rises after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 180.20 during Asian hours on Friday. The currency cross advanced as the Japanese Yen (JPY) struggled following the Bank of Japan's (BoJ) latest interest rate decision.

item.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rate by 25 bps to 1.25%, as expected
item.description: The Bank of Japan (BoJ) board members decided to raise the short-term interest rate by 25 basis points (bps) to 1.25% from 1.00%, following the conclusion of its two-day monetary policy review meeting on Friday.

item.title: British Pound jumps to two-week top as JPY declines after BoJ's rate-hike to 31-year high
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross attracts fresh buyers during the Asian session on Friday and jumps to a nearly two-week top, beyond 209.50, after the Bank of Japan (BoJ) announced its policy decision.

item.title: Japanese Yen falls like house of cards as BoJ hike interest rates by 25 bps to 1.25%
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) plunges against the US Dollar (USD) after the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) monetary policy decision. As of writing, the USD/JPY pair surges to near 156.95.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises to near $66.00 as US-10 year yield slides
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground for the second successive day, trading around $65.80 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Friday. Non-yielding Silver gained support as falling oil prices helped ease inflation concerns, which in turn pushed government bond yields lower.

item.title: Australian Dollar strengthens on hawkish RBA comments
item.description: AUD/USD extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.7120 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair is appreciating as the Australian Dollar (AUD) strengthens following hawkish comments from Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Michele Bullock.

item.title: British Pound flatlines above 1.3350, UK Retail Sales data in focus
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades on a flat note around 1.3360 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. Traders continue to assess the latest interest rate decisions and policy cues from the US Federal Reserve (Fed) and the Bank of England (BoE).

item.title: Canadian Dollar bears retain control near August 7 low amid US-Canada rate gap/trade war
item.description: The USD/CAD pair oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Friday, trading below the 1.4000 psychological mark or the highest level since August 7, touched earlier this week.

item.title: WTI drops as Middle East supply fears ease
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price remains subdued for the third successive day, trading around $96.40 per barrel during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7521 vs. 6.7580 previous
item.description: On Friday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7521 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.7580 and 6.7065 Reuters estimate.

item.title: Japanese Yen flirts with two-week low vs USD after CPI report, ahead of BoJ
item.description: The USD/JPY pair attracts fresh buyers during the Asian session on Friday and currently trades above the 156.00 mark, near a two-week high as traders await the outcome of a two-day Bank of Japan (BoJ) meeting.

item.title: Euro nudges higher above 1.1450 as US yields, oil retreat
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades with mild gains around 1.1480 during the early Asian session on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) edges lower against the Euro (EUR) amid lower US Treasury yields and moderating oil prices. Federal Reserve (Fed) Governor Michelle Bowman is set to speak later on Friday.

item.title: Iran’s IRGC claims attack on Togolese oil tanker for 'illegal transit' in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) said on Thursday that a Togo-flagged oil ‌tanker was struck ‌while attempting to make an “illegal passage” through the Strait of ‌Hormuz, Arab news reported.

item.title: RBA's Bullock: At August board meeting, risks to outlook were skewed to the upside
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Governor Michele Bullock said on Friday that risks to outlook were skewed to the upside at August board meeting.

item.title: 1.9%: Japan’s National CPI steadies in August
item.description: Japan’s National Consumer Price Index (CPI) climbed by 1.9% YoY in August, compared to the previous reading of 1.9%, according to the latest data released by the Japan Statistics Bureau on Friday.

item.title: Gold rebounds to near $4,350 on weaker US Dollar, falling oil prices
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) rises to near $4,345 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal rebounds from a six-week low amid falling oil prices and a weaker US Dollar (USD). Traders continue to assess the latest Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike and policy cues.

item.title: Australian Dollar finds a floor as Oil retreat loosens USD’s grip
item.description: The Australian Dollar recovered some ground versus the US Dollar on Thursday, following the Federal Reserve’s monetary policy decision on Wednesday, which witnessed a 0.25% rate hike and paved the way for further tightening.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Spinning tops warn bulls near 180.00
item.description: The EUR/JPY drops by about 0.08% on Thursday, forming back-to-back spinning tops near the 180.00 area, the top of a consolidation range capped to the downside by 178.00. At the time of writing, the cross-pair trades at 179.02, below its opening price.

item.title: US Dollar slips against the Japanese Yen before the Bank of Japan raises rates
item.description: USD/JPY trades near 156.00 after a session high at 156.32 and a low at 155.34, which leaves it three Yen above the September 8 low and four below the September 2 high. The Bank of Japan announces at 02:45 GMT on Friday and a quarter-point increase to 1.25% is priced at 100%.

item.title: British Pound slides after the Bank of England stays put
item.description: GBP/USD trades near 1.3350 on Thursday after a session low at 1.3336, its weakest since the end of July, and it has been under its 200-day average since Wednesday.

item.title: GBP/JPY Price Forecast: Evening star puts 207.00 back in play
item.description: GBP/JPY makes a U-turn and loses about 0.39% on Thursday as risk appetite improves, while traders await a potential rate hike by the Bank of Japan (BoJ) later in Friday’s session. The cross-pair trades at 208.32 after reaching a high of 209.19.

item.title: Singapore Dollar: Strong Dollar keeps pair supported – OCBC
item.description: OCBC strategist Christopher Wong highlights that Singapore Dollar (SGD) remains largely driven by the broader Dollar story after the FOMC, given its high sensitivity to USD moves.
